name: PopResume
provenance: Hand-maintained: no repo script regenerates this file. Written on 2026-10-19 from $HBM_EXTERNAL_ROOT/popresume/MANIFEST.json, the acquirer's full manifest (outside git). bytes and sha256 were measured on the verified raw files and equal that manifest wherever it lists the same file; extracted members were also checked against the archive they come from. A tree_sha256 is scripts/fetch_external_data.py::tree_digest of the directory.

fetch.note: the public code repository: generation and scoring code, content pools and 5 JDs, no resumes; it has no licence file

blocked.reason: the resumes (Hugging Face sumin-yu/PopResume, text config 12.8 MB) are gated with manual approval by the authors, and unauthenticated requests get HTTP 401 GatedRepo. Only the 5 public JDs are fetched and staged.
steps: Log in to huggingface.co, open https://huggingface.co/datasets/sumin-yu/PopResume, review the conditions, agree to share your contact information and request access; wait for the authors' approval (status at https://huggingface.co/settings/gated-repos).

Create a read token at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens (classic Read, or fine-grained with 'Read access to contents of all public gated repos you can access') and export HF_TOKEN=hf_... in your shell (never commit it), or run `hf auth login`.
Download only the text config (skip the ~15.9 GB of images): `hf download sumin-yu/PopResume --repo-type dataset --include 'data/text/*' README.md --local-dir <external root>/popresume/raw/hf`.

Record the downloaded files' bytes and sha256 in data/external_manifests/popresume.json and port a CV stager into scripts/external/stage_popresume.py; the acquirer's draft (_scripts/popresume/stage_popresume_text.py) was tested only on fabricated rows.
